core:p078:l002.text: s Dragonmaster (DM), your job is to balance your agendas and principles to provide a rich draconic world that your players can explore. This job can seem intimidating, but is actually a really fun way to guide a story that you and your friends will remember for years to come. This chapter is all about the tools I’ve built to help you tell your story!
